description: The triforce aims to develop a smart health monitoring software system designed to monitor and track the health conditions of astronauts during space missions. The software collects and analyzes important health parameters such as heart rate, body temperature, blood oxygen level (SpO₂), and other vital signs.
summary: ASTRA-MED is an interactive astronaut health assessment and spaceflight risk management console developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. The application integrates physiological body mapping, biometric telemetry monitoring, and actionable mission protocols into a single accessible web interface.   Deep-space missions expose crews to five primary hazards: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity fields, and hostile/closed environments. ASTRA-MED addresses this challenge by translating complex biomedical data into clear, real-time visualizations that help astronauts track physiological changes and execute timely countermeasures.   As human spaceflight pushes beyond low-Earth orbit toward the Moon and Mars, communication delays make autonomous, onboard medical decision-support critical. ASTRA-MED empowers crews to proactively monitor health risks and maintain mission readiness when immediate ground support isn't possible
details:
Project Overview & Functionality ASTRA-MED is an interactive astronaut health assessment and spaceflight risk management console. It functions as a specialized web application that combines physiological body mapping, real-time biometric telemetry, and guided mission protocols into an intuitive interface.

Addressing the Challenge & Hazards The project is built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge to tackle the five primary physiological and environmental hazards of human spaceflight: space radiation, isolation and confinement, distance from Earth, altered gravity fields, and hostile/closed environments. It works by translating complex medical telemetry into clear, visual indicators that help crews track physical changes and execute timely countermeasures.

Benefits & Intended Impact As deep-space missions venture further from Earth, communication delays make autonomous, onboard medical support essential. ASTRA-MED empowers astronauts to monitor health risks independently, ensuring sustained crew well-being and mission readiness when immediate ground control assistance is unavailable.

Tools & Technologies The project was developed using modern web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React) and deployed using GitHub Pages for seamless accessibility.

Creativity & Design Factors ASTRA-MED stands out by bridging aerospace medicine with a gamified, mission-critical dashboard design. Key factors considered by the team include deep-space autonomy constraints, rapid visual comprehension under high-stress environments, and comprehensive coverage across all major spaceflight health stressors.
